name: tests-75pct-goth-rotating-credential-epochs-across-cf0b
instr:
Support rotating credentials in Goth. Copy immutable values with nonempty opaque epochs; resolve once when credential-dependent work begins and pin through callback completion. Constructors remain lazy; repeated initiations resolve independently.

Resolution failures return `*CredentialError` with provider name, nonempty operation, and an unwrap chain preserving the cause. Failed initiation returns a nil session, and a later initiation retries resolution once. Resolution failures cause no redirects, requests, or stored bindings.

Gothic atomically stores epochs with provider sessions and restores them before authorization or credential-dependent profiles. Legacy `gothic.GetAuthURL` must create the same credential binding for source-backed providers as `GetAuthURLWithCredentialSource`. Reject missing, mismatched, replaced-provider, and cross-provider bindings before requests without modifying stored state. Invalid callback state must be rejected before requests while leaving the stored lifecycle available for a corrected callback. Completion, logout, and replacement remove only matching epoch data without cross-binding or orphaning epochs.

Preserve legacy constructors, names, defaults, registry identity, URLs, authentication results, scopes, and authorization options. Rotated customized GitHub callbacks retain endpoints; concurrent Google lifecycles across rotation and same-name replacement retain separate epochs/options.

Provider constructors:
- GitHub, Discord, Google, Git
